summary: Mount Logan Capital Inc. filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026, disclosing entry into a Third Amended and Restated Guaranty (dated April 7, 2026). The company assumed guarantor obligations for MLC US Holdings LLC under a Credit Agreement dated August 20, 2021. The guaranty requires the company to maintain minimum Net Worth of $40 million and restricts additional debt to Permitted Debt only.
